31st October2023
Dear Shivam Jaiswal,
Offer Letter – Internship Program (SAKSHAM)
Hindustan Unilever Limited (the “Company”) is pleased to make you an offer to join the internship
programme administered by it, and to undertake project(s) in the course of the same. The terms
of the programme are below:
1. The live project would be for a fixed period of 6 months which would commence from
20th November 2023 to 20th May 2024.
2. You will be working from Hindustan Unilever Limited, Chakala Andheri East, Mumbai.
3. Company has a 5-day working week and the same will be applicable to you as well. You
shall be required to be physically present at the office to undertake the project(s) allocated
to you in the course of the internship.
4. For each project allocated, you would be assigned to a project mentor who would
supervise and guide you on the project deliverables and outcomes expected. The exact
details of the project(s) would be shared with you on the commencement of your
internship.
5. Your performance during each project would be evaluated and your confirmation will be
discussed by the close of the period of internship. Confirmation shall be within the
absolute discretion of the Company management and neither this letter nor
communications associated therewith shall constitute any assurance or guarantee of
confirmation or construed as an offer of employment with the Company.

6. You will be permitted to use resources provided to you by the Company (including desktop
or laptop), only for the purpose of discharging your duties. Any unauthorised usage of the
firm’s material will result in immediate termination of your association with the project and
our Company.
7. You would be paid a monthly stipend of INR 40,000 (Indian Rupees Forty Thousand Only)
which would be paid to you at the end of every calendar month.
8. Whilst engaged in the internship project with the Company, you will not be permitted to
engage in any external activities of a commercial nature or take up employment or any
other engagement whether on a full-time or part-time basis and whether paid or unpaid,
with any other person or entity, without prior written approval from the Company.
9. Apart from weekly offs (Saturday and Sunday) and Company holidays – you will be eligible
for a total of 6 days leave during the project period, with prior approval from your
mentor/guide. You should not take any leave during the project duration unless
authorised in advance by your project mentor/guide. Any unauthorised leave from the
project could result in termination of the entire internship project and/or cessation of your
association with the project as well as from the Company.
10. Medical expenses incurred in India by you including domiciliary and OPD expenses
(medical consultations, investigations, appliance cost and so on) only related to the
medical disability, hospitalization expenses up to INR 2,00,000 (Rupees Two Lakhs only)
will be reimbursed based on actuals which will be on production of bills during your tenure
with us (family members & dependents will not be covered). It is clarified that expenses
incurred on Allopathic system of medicine only, are reimbursable. Expenses incurred on
the other systems (Homeopathy, Ayurvedic, Unani, Acupuncture, Naturopathy, etc.) will
not be considered for reimbursement.

11. If you are relocating from another city to Bangalore for the period of internship, a stay for
7 days (inclusive of weekends) will be arranged for you by the company. Please note that
such stay will be on sharing basis. The accommodation (bed and breakfast, excludes other
meals) will be provided only to the intern and any accompanying family members will not
be eligible for the stay. The intern must inform the Company at least 1 (one) week in
advance of the joining date to avail this facility.
12. Company is committed to collaborate with eligible employees in exploring reasonable
work accommodations that enable persons with disabilities to perform their jobs
successfully. The Company has a Disability Accommodations Policy and accordingly is
open to making reasonable accommodations and adjustments needed to support the
eligible employee including physical adjustments, assistive technology or cultural training
that employees may need to perform at their best.
13. You may be required to sign a non-disclosure agreement depending on the confidentiality
of the project and at the option of the Company.
14. You will receive detailed feedback as well as project completion certificate subject to the
successful and timely completion of your project.
15. Upon conclusion of the project, you will return to the Company all the assets and property
of the Company within such timelines as may be specified to you by the Company.

The Company shall have the option to terminate the internship with immediate effect in case of
any default on your part in complying with law and/or the terms of this letter, and with 3 (three)
days’ notice for any other reason. In case of termination of internship due to default, the Company
shall not provide any experience letter, internship certificate or similar document.
Kindly provide your acceptance of the terms by signing and returning a copy of this letter within 3
(three) working days hereof.
Thanking you,
For Hindustan Unilever Limited
Adfer Muzaffar
Global R&D HRBP Skin Cleansing & R&D HR Head South Asia

____________________________
Accepted
Shivam Jaiswal
